definitions.explanation: Formal negotiations between parties with differing interests, aimed at reaching a compromise or agreement. More formal than everyday negotiation and often involves institutional or organizational parties.

examples.japanese: {相手方|あいてがた}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{折衝|せっしょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{重|かさ}ねた→重ねる：02039_kasaneru⟧。
examples.english: We conducted repeated negotiations with the other party.

examples.japanese: {労使間|ろうしかん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{折衝|せっしょう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{難航|なんこう}している→難航する：19360_nankousuru⟧。
examples.english: The negotiations between labor and management are proving difficult.

examples.japanese: ⟦{予算|よさん}→予算：03663_yosan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{配分|はいぶん}→配分：14495_haibun⟧⟦について→〜について：03103_nitsuite⟧⟦{各部署|かくぶしょ}→各部署：29114_kakubusho⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{折衝|せっしょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: Negotiations with each department regarding budget allocation will be necessary.

notes:
USAGE:
A formal word used primarily in business, government, and diplomatic contexts. More rigid and serious in tone than ⟦{交渉|こうしょう}→交渉：02727_koushou⟧, which is the general word for "negotiation." {折衝|せっしょう} implies a process of back-and-forth bargaining where each side makes concessions.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {折衝|せっしょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{重|かさ}ねる→重ねる：02039_kasaneru⟧: to negotiate repeatedly
- {折衝|せっしょう}⟦{役|やく}→役：12557_yaku⟧: negotiator
- {折衝|せっしょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{難航|なんこう}する→難航する：19360_nankousuru⟧: negotiations become difficult

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{交渉|こうしょう}→交渉：02727_koushou⟧: negotiation (general, broader usage)
- ⟦{協議|きょうぎ}→協議：02635_kyougi⟧: consultation, discussion (more collaborative tone)
